contract.title: POOF and Clifford constitutional publication ecology

poof_source_custody.title: The People Outside the Objective Function
poof_source_custody.allowed_use: structural publication mapping and local-authority integration only
poof_source_custody.forbidden_use: private manuscript text cannot serve as the sole support for a public factual assertion

governing_law.statement: Evidence authority moves outward. Challenges move inward. Publication never writes facts backward into the evidence estate.
evidence_outward: canonical receipts, claims, events, identities, surfaces, and reviewed cases
deterministic Clifford compilations and structured reports
POOF passages, Decision Files, REAL STEEL and Steel Mirror projections
challenge_inward: reader, subject, journalist, examiner, accessibility, browser, or machine-audit observation
ordinary Clifford intake, source, selection, temporal, privacy, and human-review gates
canonical correction or evidence change only after normal promotion
no_reverse_authority: POOF prose cannot create a canonical claim
a reader interaction cannot create a finding
a WebsiteIQ score cannot establish substantive truth
a comprehension receipt cannot establish agreement or case truth
REAL STEEL or Steel Mirror similarity cannot define a denominator
MCP or API narration cannot add facts

jurisdictions.label: Report
jurisdictions.function: Stable linear argument compiled from source-addressable projection manifests.
jurisdictions.may: Sequence reviewed evidence, analytical judgments, boundaries, counterevidence, and accepted ceilings.
jurisdictions.may_not: Invent evidence, silently promote a candidate, or hide source and qualification state.

jurisdictions.label: Reader File
jurisdictions.function: Local, contestable record of the reader’s declared role, objective, threshold, inspected objects, route changes, and teach-back.
jurisdictions.may: Support export, erasure, rerouting, comprehension testing, and voluntary challenge submission.
jurisdictions.may_not: Infer motive, ideology, intelligence, agreement, or substantive case truth.

jurisdictions.label: Examination
jurisdictions.function: Interdisciplinary proceedings that expose unresolved propositions, external audits, counterevidence, and repair obligations.
jurisdictions.may: Issue graph-inert referrals naming the required record, test, custodian, and consequence of nonresolution.
jurisdictions.may_not: Bypass canonical promotion or impersonate adjudication not actually performed.

jurisdictions.label: Estate
jurisdictions.function: Durable custody for Person Files, Decision Files, receipts, maps, audits, versions, corrections, counterfactuals, and exit drills.
jurisdictions.may: Preserve conflicting versions and exact release custody.
jurisdictions.may_not: Become an independent factual ledger that diverges from Clifford.

authority_stack.label: Canonical evidence
authority_stack.authority: facts, identities, events, receipts, review state

authority_stack.label: POOF publication projections
authority_stack.authority: argument and presentation bounded by projection manifests

authority_stack.label: Reader, newsroom, examination, and audit interactions
Graph-inert referral intake
authority_stack.authority: research question and acquisition route only

instruments.forbidden_inference: A dossier, actor position, or recurring shape is not a personality score, wrongdoing finding, or neutral denominator.
Differential treatment or ownership does not by itself establish comparable hazards, bad faith, illegality, or hypocrisy.
Passing establishes operational evidence discipline only, not truth, agreement, or publication readiness.
Interface quality, accessibility, discoverability, performance, or machine readability cannot establish a substantive claim.

source_authority: compiled Clifford and POOF projection manifests
instruments.forbidden_inference: Machine narration cannot detach qualifications, infer motive, or create evidence.

release_loop: freeze a reviewed Clifford evidence release
compile POOF Report, Reader File, Examination, Estate, and projection manifests
build human and machine Evidence Desk surfaces
run structural, accessibility, link, MCP, API, and interpretation-contract validation
run cold-reader and newsroom comprehension tests
audit the deployed origin through WebsiteIQ and other external examiners
route publication defects to publication remediation
route substantive objections to graph-inert Clifford referrals
promote evidence changes only through ordinary Clifford review
regenerate POOF from the new frozen evidence release while preserving prior releases

operational_effect_law.statement: Graph-inert is not power-inert. Every transaction must declare each operational effect it may exercise.

constitutional_amendment_law.statement: A constitutional rule may change only through a receipted, migration-aware repository transaction whose consequences remain inspectable.

bindings.selection_requirement: role-neutral K0 denominator or clearly marked fixture/boundary status
bindings.approval_requirement: ordinary claim, event, receipt, temporal, selection, privacy, and independent-review gates

bindings.selection_requirement: same or materially comparable hazard, independently sourced self-regime and other-regime, and practical-remedy evidence
bindings.approval_requirement: context, scale, legal duty, fiduciary role, security, technical feasibility, and counterevidence review

claim_classes.definition: An act, statement, decision, gate, consequence, or changed explanation directly supported by a canonical object or receipt.
A bounded inference from documented acts whose alternatives, confidence, and disconfirming evidence are stated.
A causal model used to organize evidence that is not represented as an observed internal state or diagnosis.

report_map.placement: after Chapter 14 and before Part IV / Chapter 15
report_map.label: Interlude: Who Is Permitted to Count as a Knower?
report_map.purpose: Introduce K0, explanation mutation, feedback-source removal, and the distinction between comprehension failure and strategic bypass.
report_map.content_rule: one supported case, one boundary case, and an explicit evidence ceiling

report_map.label: The Constitution They Keep for Themselves
report_map.purpose: Compare the safeguards reserved by a center with those made practically available to affected people under a materially comparable hazard.
report_map.content_rule: state the self-regime, other-regime, comparability limit, error-cost allocation, and practical remedy

report_map.placement: Methodological Note: The POOF Evidence Constitution
report_map.label: Publication interfaces and evidence authority
report_map.purpose: Separate substantive receipts, publication projections, reader interactions, comprehension tests, interface audits, and external review.
report_map.content_rule: every object states what it proves, what it cannot prove, and whether it can write back

report_map.label: K0 through C7
report_map.purpose: Show K0 as the admissibility gate before and inside C1 and C2 without replacing the seven conversion stages.
report_map.content_rule: R8 and R9 remain report projections, not stages

report_map.label: K0 preflight and Steel Mirror pass
report_map.purpose: Add admissibility, contradiction, reclassification, safeguard allocation, error-cost, and practical-remedy checks to the existing audit.
report_map.content_rule: no universal score and no automatic bad-faith inference

examination_map.title: Can a cold reporter safely use the estate?
Can machines discover the evidence without flattening it?
examination_map.failure_route: publication remediation, not substantive evidence change

examination_map.title: Does POOF reproduce the comprehension ceiling it criticizes?
Does POOF reserve greater safeguards for itself than for its subjects?
examination_map.failure_route: publication block until asymmetry is explained or repaired

changes.reason: Adversarial review identified non-graph power, opaque selection, amendment, inference, and forced-symmetry bypasses.
previous_behavior: transaction objects declared graph and canonical effects but not all operational effects
projection manifests identified included sources without binding the compression procedure
constitutional files could change without a dedicated amendment receipt
proposed_behavior: all transaction schemas carry exact seven-dimension effect contracts
projection manifests bind candidate universe, selection, ordering, truncation, missingness, counterevidence, null-result, and override rules
protected constitutional changes carry a durable change record and adversarial fixtures
changes.migration: Existing staged fixtures and the generated aperture are regenerated under additive version-one fields before any deployment.
changes.backward_compatibility: No canonical evidence object, graph edge, claim, receipt, identity, event, or prior release is rewritten; old releases retain their original interpretation contracts.

reportContracts.label: Epistemic admissibility and ceiling-conversion dossier
reportContracts.question: When a qualified knower contradicts the governing model, how is the knower reclassified, which gate makes that reclassification operative, what material consequence follows, and who can preserve the evidence and stay the action?

reportContracts.label: Two-tier constitution and safeguard-allocation audit
reportContracts.question: What protection does a center preserve for itself, what analogous protection is practically available to affected people, are the hazards materially comparable, who controls both regimes, who bears error, and which remedies or exits work?
required_panels: context, scale, law, security, and feasibility differences

k0.definition: K0 records who is permitted to count as a knower before problem vocabulary and the eligible option set are formed.

steel_mirror.title: The two-tier constitution and safeguard-allocation story
steel_mirror.question: Which safeguards, contextual review, evidence access, exceptions, appeal, substitution, and exit does the center preserve for itself, which does it make practically available to others under a comparable hazard, and who bears the error when they differ?

steel_mirror_lane.title: Steel Mirror safeguard allocation
steel_mirror_lane.question: Under a materially comparable hazard, what safeguard does the center preserve, what safeguard governs affected people, does the same authority control both regimes, who bears error and delay, and which remedy or exit works in practice?
steel_mirror_lane.falsifier: The hazards are not materially comparable, different legal or operational duties explain the differential, the center does not control both regimes, equivalent practical safeguards exist, or the alleged asymmetry does not survive exact-record review.
steel_mirror_lane.stopping_rule: Terminate each pair as context-explained, unequal safeguard allocation, same-hazard safeguard reserved, insufficiently comparable, bounded non-link, falsified, source-restricted, or requiring a named additional acquisition.
